definitions.supplemental: v. scúr, I b; and cf. heoru hamere geþuren, Beo. Th. 2575; B. 1285

quotations.old_english: Ðæt him féla láf (the sword) ne meahte scúrheard sceþþan

source_text: scúr-heard; adj. Made hard by blows (v. scúr, I b; and cf. heoru hamere geþuren, Beo. Th. 2575; B. 1285):--Sweordes ecg, scerp and scúrheard, Andr. Kmbl. 2267; An. 1135. Ðæt him féla láf (the sword) ne meahte scúrheard sceþþan, Beo. Th. 2070; B. 1033.
